attributes.name: ypy-scope
attributes.description: Marks an element as a scope. The selector `scope` (in `ypy-target`, `ypy-indicator`, `ypy-include`, `ypy.find()`...) is the closest element with this attribute, the element itself included; `scope <selector>` searches inside it. Two more selectors come with the extension: `layer` (the topmost open layer of `ypy-layers`) and `shadow:<selector>` (a search that enters nested open shadow roots and follows the slots). The value is not used.
